===== FILE 20063__1.pdf =====
ROBERT VINSON Brannum 
rbrannum@robertbrannum.com  
September 2, 2025 
The Honorable Douglas Collins 
Secretary 
Department of Veterans Affairs 
Washington, DC 
RE: Proposed Rule 
Dear Mr Secretary, 
As printed in the Federal Register, "The Department of Veterans Affairs 
(VA) is proposing to reinstate the full exclusion on abortions and abortion 
counseling from the medical benefits package, which was removed in 2022. 
Before that time, this exclusion had been firmly in place since the medical 
benefits package was first established in 1999. VA is also proposing to reinstate 
the exclusions on abortion and abortion counseling for Civilian Health and 
Medical Program of the Department of Veterans Affairs (CHAMPVA) that were 
removed in 2022. We take this action to ensure that VA provides only needed 
medical services to our nation's heroes and their families." 
I am a service-connected disabled veteran. I am a man. I strongly 
oppose this proposed rule. It is clearly and demonstrably discriminatory. 
Further, I join those who view abortion as essential care which should be 
veterans in cases of rape, incest, or when pregnancy endangered a veteran's 
health or life. Let me be clear and precise, the right to an abortion is a right to 
be included in health care. 
This proposed rule is offensive to justice, decency, and a blatant 
disregard for the health of veterans who need this medical service. This rule 
hinders the availability of veterans to receive full and complete medical 
treatment. This proposed rule is dishonest and should not be affirmed.
